title: cleanup_tmp_files: non-UTF-8 path silently skipped (asymmetry with round-5 fix)
description: Path with non-UTF-8 component: path.to_str() returns None → !is_some_and(...) is true → skip condition fires → tmp file silently retained forever. The round-5 fix applied path.extension() to cleanup_orphan_msg_files but left cleanup_tmp_files using path.to_str().is_some_and(|s| s.ends_with('.msg.tmp') || s.ends_with('.env.tmp')). The two startup scans now have inconsistent predicate logic.
